Name: Alecto Witch Rarecrow Replacement
Author: abelardthebard
Description: Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/7439530]zoedoll[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10671]Alecto the Witch mod[/url], I thought I'd take things an extra step (with permission to use the sprite). This mod replaces Rarecrow #2's slanderous depiction of witches and replaces it with a scarecrow based on the Alecto sprite. The standard scarecrow uses Alecto's winter sprite. I've also created an alternate with her standard sprite that is wearing the craftable witch hat (recolored to match her dress). Simply swap the names of the files in the assets folder if you want to use that one.

Downloads.Description: Replaces Rarecrow #2 (Witch) with an Alecto-themed design from zoedoll's Alecto the Witch mod
